# Self-signed EC P-256 edge certificates (CA:TRUE, SAN=localhost), each pinned as its own
# trust anchor and presented as the one-cert chain, to exercise EKU enforcement on the
# end-entity itself (the leaf is also the anchor):
#   clientauth_selfsigned_cert - extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth only; rejected as a SERVER
#     certificate (unsupported_certificate) even though it is directly trusted.
#   malformed_eku_selfsigned_cert - an extendedKeyUsage extension whose value is not a
#     SEQUENCE OF OID (a bare INTEGER); rejected as bad_certificate, not internal_error.
# Both are valid 2020-01-01..2126-09-15 (Go crypto/x509, a fresh key each).
clientauth_selfsigned_
malformed_eku_selfsigned_
